question: In which state was the 'Viksit Krishi Sankalp Abhiyan (VKSA)' launched by the Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Viksit Krishi Sankalp Abhiyan (VKSA)** was officially launched in the state of **Odisha** in **May 2025** to spearhead a new era of agricultural transformation.
 
• The initiative was inaugurated by the **Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan**, emphasizing the central government's commitment to revitalizing the primary sector in eastern India.
 
• The primary objective of **VKSA** is to bridge the gap between scientific research and field application by providing **farmers** with direct access to **high-yield seed varieties** and modern **agri-technology**.
 
• The program serves as a critical component of the broader **Viksit Bharat @2047** vision, aiming to make Indian agriculture globally competitive and **climate-resilient**.
 
• Under this abhiyan, special focus is placed on **soil health management** and the promotion of **integrated farming systems**
